page_title: INT 2-2 BOL | Inter v Bologna 15/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Luca Pairetto has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Davide Frattesi (Inter) commits a rough foul. Luca Pairetto stops the game and makes a call.
90+2' Nicolo Barella (Inter) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
90+2' Marcus Thuram (Inter) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Denzel Dumfries (Inter) but poses no threat.
88' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Martin Erlic (Bologna) replaces Remo Freuler.
87' Santiago Castro doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
87' Looks like Santiago Castro (Bologna) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
86' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 12:14. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 6:6.
84' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

84' Marcus Thuram (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' A substitution has been made. Alessandro Bastoni goes off and Tajon Buchanan (Inter) comes on.
83' Luca Pairetto blows the whistle, Nicolo Barella (Inter) is penalised for a foul.
81' Inter get a corner.

80' Marcus Thuram (Inter) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Mehdi Taremi was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Inter can continue in their attacking effort.
78' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
76' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) replacing Emil Holm.
74' Here comes a substitution. Mehdi Taremi (Inter) is brought on as a substitute for Lautaro Martinez.
73' Simone Inzaghi is stunned as referee Luca Pairetto shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
72' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for an infringement.
70' Here is a change. Matteo Darmian is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Benjamin Pavard (Inter).
70' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Federico Dimarco will be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
70' That will be all from Kristjan Asllani who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Davide Frattesi (Inter).
69' The resulting corner from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

68' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Yann Sommer makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! Bologna have a corner.
67' Substitution. Jens Odgaard makes his way off the pitch and Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) comes on as his replacement.
67' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Nikola Moro is replaced by Tommaso Pobega (Bologna).

67' A precise low pass is received by Emil Holm (Bologna), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
65' Flag goes up against Marcus Thuram (Inter) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
64' 2 - 2 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini plays it to Emil Holm (Bologna), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Yann Sommer. 2:2.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
62' The ball is cleared after Dan Ndoye (Bologna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Bologna earn a corner.
61' Federico Dimarco (Inter) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

61' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Lukasz Skorupski pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is caught offside!
60' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
58' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) dribbles into the box, but Lukasz Skorupski is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
56' Nicolo Casale (Bologna) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Pairetto signals.

55' What a chance that is! Federico Dimarco (Inter) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
53' Referee Luca Pairetto sees the trip by Nicolo Casale (Bologna) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Inter.
52' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the middle of the goal from distance, but Yann Sommer hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
51' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
50' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Marcus Thuram (Inter) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
49' Nikola Moro (Bologna) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' 2 - 1 Goal! Federico Dimarco provides Lautaro Martinez (Inter) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort under the bar. 2:1.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.

43' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is behind the touchline and Bologna will take a throw-in.
40' The linesman raises his flag. Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is adjudged offside.

38' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
38' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
37' The foul by Emil Holm (Bologna) was seen by Luca Pairetto who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
35' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar.
35' Federico Dimarco (Inter) passes the ball onto Marcus Thuram, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
34' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) serves up a nice cross, but Lukasz Skorupski punches the ball away.

31' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Lukasz Skorupski displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
30' Chance! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Marcus Thuram, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the left post.
30' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
28' Nicolo Barella (Inter) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
26' Emil Holm (Bologna) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
25' Federico Dimarco (Inter) releases a superb dipping volley at goal from the edge of the box that flies just wide of the right post.

24' This was a piece of cake for Lukasz Skorupski. Denzel Dumfries (Inter) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
23' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle after Federico Dimarco (Inter) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
20' No offside! Referee Luca Pairetto points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Inter players celebrate.
19' The Inter players halt their celebrations as referee Luca Pairetto makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
19' 1 - 1 The goalkeeper makes a superb save, but the ball rebounds off him out to Denzel Dumfries (Inter), who fires a shot into the middle of the net.
19' A pass into the box finds Federico Dimarco (Inter) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Lukasz Skorupski denies him.
18' The ball is behind the sideline. Matteo Darmian (Inter) takes a throw-in.
15' 0 - 1 Goal! Nikola Moro takes aim and his effort deflects off Santiago Castro (Bologna) to beat the goalkeeper. 0:1.
13' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' Matteo Darmian (Inter) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
11' Remo Freuler (Bologna) trips an opposition player and Luca Pairetto signals a foul.

9' What a great touch by Nikola Moro (Bologna) after latching on to a precise pass on the edge of the box! He finds some space and rips a shot close to the right post. The goalkeeper makes an astonishing save, knocking the ball onto the post.
8' Marcus Thuram (Inter) brings an opponent down and Luca Pairetto interrupts the game.
7' Poor challenge! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is penalised for tripping and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle.
6' Marcus Thuram (Inter) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
4' Luca Pairetto interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Marcus Thuram (Inter).
2' Denzel Dumfries is the provider with a good cross and Marcus Thuram (Inter) shows great determination to get to the ball on the edge of the box, but he blazes it high over the bar.
2' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bologna will have the kick-off.
Luca Pairetto will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
